name: zornov
description: Edit video with Zornov: Claude makes, cuts, checks and exports a Zornov project with Zornov's own tools.
long_description: This extension starts the Zornov installed on this computer; it does not contain a copy of it. Install Zornov first, from https://github.com/zornov/zornov/releases, in its usual place: Zornov.app in Applications on macOS, the MSI on Windows, or zornov on PATH on Linux. Then choose the project folder Claude works in. If that project is open in a Zornov window, Claude works in the window and you see each edit as it happens.

project.title: Project folder
project.description: The Zornov project Claude works in. An empty folder becomes a new project.
